To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for admin meeting

Hey Renee,

Here’s the football rundown for today’s meeting. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we’ve got a HOME playoff game Friday and we’d love to see folks come out and support these kids.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night and locked up second place in the region. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and two touchdowns. His long TD in the third was a big one, but I’ve got to give our line some love too. They pushed Brookhollow five yards back on that whole drive. Best I’ve seen them block all year.

Deshawn Pettaway had three sacks and seven tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met. Our defense held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half.

We host Clanton Valley in the first round Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Presale starts Tuesday. We need to confirm the gate and chain crews by Wednesday, and the boosters need six more people for concessions. If we win and go on the road, I’ll get the bus stuff to you. I remember transportation needs those requests five days out.

On academics, all 52 kids on the roster are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Tonya deserves the credit there, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason the grades are clean, and she’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale did great too: 208 sold and $6,240 raised, beating the $4,500 goal. The money is going toward new sideline headsets. Please thank Carla and the boosters, and Hargrove’s Meat Market for smoking them at cost.
